edition.title: NPNF First Series, Volume I: The Confessions and Letters of St. Augustin

alternate_titles: The Confessions and Letters of St. Augustin, with a Sketch of his Life and Work
work.author: Philip Schaff
work.description: The first volume of the first series of the Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers translation anthology, containing Augustine's Confessions and a selection of his letters in English with Schaff's prolegomena. Its container identity remains distinct from Augustine's works and the translated editions printed within it.
work.title: A Select Library of Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, First Series, Volume I
